limits: Instrumentation adds unknown RAF/Canvas/style/response-sampling overhead. Callback spans are not saved CPU time or an uninstrumented startup measurement. No retention rate is measured.

The named smallTileCalls metric counts5-argument16x16-source to4x4-destination drawImage calls under a confirmed covered drawWorld stack. All covered drawImage counts also contain36 other-shape calls in trial08. Do not equate total drawImage count with background tile count or infer pixel equivalence.
first/exit opacity/geometry are sampled, not continuous compositor observations. Successful native calls and RAF return do not prove presentation; first complete visible map was not measured.
FCP occurs much earlier than DCL. DCL duration must not be called blank-screen duration.

Public worldAvailable/worldState/trailCells are pure getter observations at first/exit only; no world array copy or game target method call. Source getter14008 and background path8765-8778 were read separately.

Touch command timestamp was explicitly set from Node epoch. eventTimeStamp reflects that supplied timestamp mapped into page time; event.at records capture-listener delivery. Neither is a real finger hardware timestamp. Node send hold, event timestamp hold, and handler arrival hold differ and are reported separately.

First position change is a read-only game-coordinate sample; positive reward evidence is DOM points text30 with badge.hidden=false at a periodic sample. These are observation upper bounds, not exact visual feedback or reward paint times. The50ms timer can be delayed; actual intervals are retained.

Guide point is CSS-derived circle center, not exact painted fingertip. The fixed-page equation assumes no additional ancestor/individual transform/zoom. General guards for those transformations and rect/matrix consistency were not implemented. All actual final guide reads happened after recorded cover removal; generic .off acceptance alone would not prove optical absence during fading.

Guide chosen from visible circle rather than hand rectangle center. Known main518 hand-body issue was not edited; no world-open outcome occurred in these circle taps. This does not validate all hand-area taps.

Only5 recorded source files and HEAD were pre/post checked, including pre-browser HTTP hashes. Routing/resolver evidence is not packet capture. Fresh-browser preflight still warms local server/filesystem.
Unmuted Chromium/CPU4/mobile emulation do not validate physical tilt sensor, real finger behavior, calibrated device performance, audio output heard by a person, or actual network latency.
The ten PNGs are after observation, not the moment of first paint or first tap. Existence/hash/dimensions are verified here; independent visual review is separate.

limits: Instrumentation adds unknown RAF/Canvas/style/response-sampling overhead. Callback spans are not saved CPU time or an uninstrumented startup measurement. No retention rate is measured.

The named smallTileCalls metric counts5-argument16x16-source to4x4-destination drawImage calls under a confirmed covered drawWorld stack. Covered drawImage counts can also contain other-shape foreground calls; inspect the recorded distribution. Do not equate total drawImage count with background tile count or infer pixel equivalence.
first/exit opacity/geometry are sampled, not continuous compositor observations. Successful native calls and RAF return do not prove presentation; first complete visible map was not measured.
FCP occurs much earlier than DCL. DCL duration must not be called blank-screen duration.

Public worldAvailable/worldState/trailCells are pure getter observations at first/exit only; no world array copy or game target method call. Before source getter14008/background8765-8778 and after source getter14051/background8759-8821 were read separately.

Touch command timestamp was explicitly set from Node epoch. eventTimeStamp reflects that supplied timestamp mapped into page time; event.at records capture-listener delivery. Neither is a real finger hardware timestamp. Node send hold, event timestamp hold, and handler arrival hold differ and are reported separately.

First position change is a read-only game-coordinate sample; positive reward evidence is DOM points text30 with badge.hidden=false at a periodic sample. These are observation upper bounds, not exact visual feedback or reward paint times. The50ms timer can be delayed; actual intervals are retained.

Guide point is CSS-derived circle center, not exact painted fingertip. The fixed-page equation assumes no additional ancestor/individual transform/zoom. General guards for those transformations and rect/matrix consistency were not implemented. All actual final guide reads happened after recorded cover removal; generic .off acceptance alone would not prove optical absence during fading.

Guide chosen from visible circle rather than hand rectangle center. Known main518 hand-body issue was not edited; no world-open outcome occurred in these circle taps. This does not validate all hand-area taps.

Only5 recorded source files and HEAD were pre/post checked, including pre-browser HTTP hashes. Routing/resolver evidence is not packet capture. Fresh-browser preflight still warms local server/filesystem.
Unmuted Chromium/CPU4/mobile emulation do not validate physical tilt sensor, real finger behavior, calibrated device performance, audio output heard by a person, or actual network latency.
The ten PNGs are after observation, not the moment of first paint or first tap. Existence/hash/dimensions are verified here; independent visual review is separate.
